author: Nicolai156
body:
• Nicolai156
  • I was banned for fly hacking and kill aura and i have also been caught lying about my ban evasions and other stuff some couple times the ign's is https://avicus.net/McFanta_ https://avicus.net/krisdenkule8 https://avicus.net/chris_er_kul i dont know really what i did when i ban evaded i think i was in lobby or something....
  • I should be unbanned because i want to become a staff member and a map maker thats my dream you can see my map thread here https://avicus.net/forums/2838c8a40 i like that thread that was pretty good and i would love to play this server with no hacks and become a pro player like all of you! I would love to be unbanned and enjoy this awesome server. And i am very sorry for lying some couple times :C i just wanted to get appeal i am a terrible person i have hacked on this server, wtf is that, hacking on server is terrible do you agree with me? I was also caught ban evading 12 days ago but i was only online on lobby i think... Thats all about why i should be unbanned.



There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • My Ban was ofc real i did hack about 2 months ago i fly hacked and used kill aura and i have also ban evaded three times.
  • Nope the ban was real.
  • I dont know i hacked about two months ago so its your choose.
  • Yes i have been caught ban evading three times but i think i only was online in lobby last time i ban evaded was 12 days ag but i didn't broke a rule or something!
  • I have never appealed a ban before and i hope this is 100 % real because this is the best appeal i can come with....

Hello,
